note: Each waiver suppresses ONE judge finding id in ONE file, only while the offending text is unchanged (sha256 of the finding's `before`, trimmed), and only until `expires`. health-claim, fake-urgency and misleading-subject findings can never be waived. Get the sha with: node -e "console.log(require('crypto').createHash('sha256').update(process.argv[1].trim()).digest('hex'))" "<before text>"
